title: Razorpay order creation bridge
context: No official ACP-Razorpay payment handler exists. This task builds the disclosed adaptation: on complete, create a real Razorpay test-mode order scoped to the session total, standing in for the ACP delegate_payment vault-token leg.
objective: Build a service function that takes a session total and creates a Razorpay Order via the Razorpay test-mode API, reusing retry/backoff logic from the Onboarding Agent codebase.
scope_in: razorpay_service.create_order(amount, currency, session_id) returning a Razorpay order object
Reuse existing retry/backoff wrapper from Onboarding Agent code — do not reimplement from scratch
Amount passed to Razorpay must exactly match session.totals.total — no silent rounding drift
scope_out: Not wiring this into the /complete endpoint yet — that's T4.2
No real card charge — Razorpay Order creation only
acceptance_criteria: Calling create_order with a test amount returns a real Razorpay test-mode order id, verifiable in the Razorpay test dashboard
A simulated transient Razorpay API failure triggers the reused retry/backoff logic, confirmed via a test that mocks one failed attempt then a success
Amount mismatch between session total and what's sent to Razorpay is impossible by construction — write a test proving this
